report_comment.text: FGFR2 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase. ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. FGFR2::ETV6 was detected in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with retention of the FGFR2 kinase domain. The primary study confirmed fusion junctions by RNA sequencing and FGFR2 rearrangement by FISH. Futibatinib is US-approved for adults with previously treated, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring an FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement.
